attr.title: Alex the Allegator 3: Radioactive Racers
attr.desc: A somewhat unfinished top-down racing game. Throttle, brake and steer around a single lap track, racing against AI opponents.
attr.desc_md: A top-down racing game by [Johan Peitz](http://allegator.sourceforge.net/), made for the 2002 "Allegro Speedhack" jam. Race against AI opponents (and a second local player) around a single track, throttling, braking and steering to place first across 5 laps. Unfinished by the author's own admission (only one track), but playable start to finish.
